name: Runner Extras - Code Coverage Start OOS
brief: Issue #3517: CODECOVERAGELOG(TRUE) reached BC's real CodeCoverageRecorder ctor and died with a bare ArgumentNullException naming the parameter 'codeEnvironment', because the runner's skeleton NCLMetadata is built with GetUninitializedObject and never assigns one. Recording statement hits into BC's AL-visible Code Coverage virtual tables is in scope but not implemented, so the START now refuses by name with the not-yet-implemented anchor. This suite pins that refusal and its scope: the query form CODECOVERAGELOG() still answers false and CODECOVERAGELOG(FALSE) still stops cleanly, both of which worked before the fix.
description: Every claim here is runner-specific by construction — which surface the runner refuses, under which name and anchor, and which surfaces it must NOT take over from BC. The plain-BC half of this surface (what a service tier records and reports through the Code Coverage virtual table) is not asserted here: it needs a real ALCodeEnvironment, which is exactly the thing the runner does not have, so a corpus test would be asserting the very capability this suite declares missing. See the PR body for why this is a runner-extras claim rather than a corpus one.
